title: Getting started with the Vector Store

cues.en: So at this point, we can successfully connect to an LLM and have a conversation, and the logic is pretty simple.
cues.zh: 目前已經能成功連接 LLM 並進行對話，邏輯相當簡單。

cues.en: Over here in config.py, we set up our configuration for our application, and we control everything from the dot on.
cues.zh: config.py 裡設定應用程式的組態，所有內容都由 .env 控制。

cues.en: So we load the dot on file.
We have a little function here that allows us to get a value from the environment, and we have this class config, which is our overall application config.
cues.zh: 再透過這個小函式取得環境中的值；Config 類別則代表整個應用程式的設定。

cues.en: So we have the config all set up.
cues.zh: 目前設定部分都已完成。

cues.en: And over in LLM, we've defined a message, the things that are sent to and received from the LLM, and we have our chat client, okay?
cues.zh: 在 llm.py 裡，我們定義了 Message，也就是與 LLM 來往的訊息，以及 ChatClient。

cues.en: And our chat client, the most important method here, of course, is the stream, the one that actually handles the conversation.
cues.zh: ChatClient 裡最重要的方法，當然是實際處理對話的 stream。

cues.en: And then over in CLI.py, we have our default system prompt.
cues.zh: cli.py 裡則有預設的系統提示詞。

cues.en: And then here in this chat command, we actually have what we call a read evaluate print loop, a little loop, this while loop, that reads the user's message,
cues.zh: 而 chat 命令實際實作了所謂的讀取、求值、輸出迴圈，也就是這個 while 迴圈，讀取使用者訊息、

cues.en: communicates with the LLM, gets the information back, and prints it to the console, all very straightforward.
cues.zh: 與 LLM 溝通、取得回覆，再輸出到主控台，全都很直接。

cues.en: But of course, our goal is to give more intelligence to the LLM, to give it a body of knowledge it might not have, a series of documents it can search and find relevant information from,
cues.zh: 但目標當然是讓 LLM 更有智慧，給它可能原本沒有的知識，也就是一系列文件，讓它搜尋、找出相關資訊，

cues.en: and use that when formulating its response.
cues.zh: 並用這些資訊組織回覆。

cues.en: And of course, this means we need somewhere to store that information.
cues.zh: 這也代表我們得有地方儲存資料。

cues.en: And where we're gonna store it initially is in Postgres, which is pretty straightforward and works really, really well, okay?
cues.zh: 一開始會存進 Postgres，它很容易使用，效果也非常好。

The first thing I'm gonna have to do is add some dependencies over here in pyproject.toml.

cues.zh: 另外還需要 pgvector，因為 Postgres 預設不支援向量資料庫。
